title: A pool deposit: transfer events to an L… address
pattern: CHANGE_TRUST to pool shares creates the liquidity-pool entry (not the deposit, which only updates it), and LIQUIDITY_POOL_DEPOSIT emits transfer events whose destination is the pool, rendered as an L… strkey (CAP-0067). Readers that create pools on deposit, or expect G or C addresses in event topics, get both wrong.

hazards.placement: pool entry created by ChangeTrust to pool shares; LiquidityPoolDeposit only updates it
liquidity-pool address L… in a CAP-0067 event topic

facts.says: mm transfers XLM to the pool, whose address is an L… strkey.
Operation 0 (CHANGE_TRUST) creates the pool entry, keyed by the same L… ID.
